altitudeAcclimation.source: Garmin MetricsHeatAltitudeAcclimation. altitudeAcclimation is metres, converted to feet here. Garmin's own model, not a measurement.

trainingLoad.source: Garmin MetricsAcuteTrainingLoad. acwr is acute:chronic workload ratio.

trainingReadiness.source: Garmin TrainingReadinessDTO. Carries sleepScore and an HRV factor percentage, but no raw SpO2 or HRV. Those live in the wellness export.

meta.note: Derived Garmin metrics. Objective, so they fall under the Garmin source-of-truth rule. Absent here: SpO2, raw HRV, sleep stages, heart-rate zone configuration, body-composition profile.
